basics.name: Emerson Quijada Rafael
basics.label: Full Stack Developer · Java & Spring Boot · Angular | Production Systems
basics.summary: Full Stack Developer with hands-on experience building and deploying business management systems to production for real clients. Currently pursuing a degree in Systems Engineering at Universidad Continental. Specialized in the Java ecosystem (Spring Boot 3.x, Java 21) with Angular 19 frontends and PostgreSQL. I've designed APIs using Hexagonal Architecture and DDD, built offline-first solutions with Service Workers for low-connectivity environments, and automated deployments with Docker Compose on Digital Ocean.

work.name: Importaciones DENRAF
work.summary: Production ERP (Vercel + Digital Ocean) for a real import and retail business operating at trade fairs. Evolved from a pure Angular application into a complete Full Stack architecture with Angular 19, Spring Boot 3.5 / Java 21, PostgreSQL, and Docker Compose. Includes 10+ modules: POS, sales history, clients, inventory with financial intelligence, dashboard, reports with Excel/PDF export, gamified vendor goals, smart notification system, multi-currency (PEN/USD), QR payments, and business settings.
highlights: Built the POS and Sales engine with transaction history, solving concurrency issues in simultaneous operations using optimistic locking with @Version in Spring Data JPA.

Designed a Financial Intelligence module using the Strategy Pattern that classifies inventory by health (active, slow, and frozen capital) based on fairs without sales, generating automatic liquidation plans to recover stalled capital.

Implemented a smart notification system that analyzes business data in real-time: low stock alerts, star product detection, sales tracking, and commercial inactivity warnings, with category filtering (critical, sales, stock).

Architected the REST API using Hexagonal Architecture and DDD, secured with JWT, role-based access control (RBAC), and covered by unit tests (JUnit/Mockito), centralizing business logic for 10+ modules in production.
Implemented offline-first architecture with IndexedDB and Service Workers so the POS operates without internet — required because trade fairs have zero or intermittent network coverage.
Migrated the frontend to Angular Signals and Lazy Loading, and automated the full stack deployment with Docker Compose on a Digital Ocean Droplet.

work.name: Calzados La Peruanita
work.summary: Production sales and inventory system for a footwear store. End-to-end design and implementation with Angular, Spring Boot, and PostgreSQL, enabling the store to digitize its invoicing, stock control, and logistics.
highlights: Designed the relational data model in PostgreSQL for hierarchical and scalable inventory management (product → color → size).
Developed secure RESTful APIs with Spring Boot to orchestrate invoicing, order management, and operational reporting.
Built a reactive and modular UI in Angular, optimizing the administrator's workflows for stock and sales control.
Automated the Full Stack ecosystem deployment across multiple cloud environments (Render for backend, Vercel for frontend).
